faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Get your questions answered about the system.

item1.question: How does the trial period work?
item1.answer: You have 14 days to test all features without commitment. No credit card required.

item2.question: Can I connect multiple Mercado Libre accounts?
item2.answer: Yes! All plans support multiple Mercado Libre accounts in a single dashboard.

item3.question: Is my data secure?
item3.answer: Absolutely. We use end-to-end encryption and follow all LGPD regulations.

item4.question: Can I cancel anytime?
item4.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time without penalties or additional fees.

item5.question: Do you offer support?
item5.answer: Yes, we offer chat and email support for all plans. Premium plans have priority support.

item6.question: How does billing work?
item6.answer: Billing is done monthly via credit card or PIX, according to your plan.
